title: 2025 AMC 12A Problem 19
statement:
Let \(a,\) \(b,\) and \(c\) be the roots of the polynomial \(x^3 + kx + 1.\) What is the sum

\[ \begin{aligned} &a^3b^2 + a^2b^3 + b^3c^2 \\ &\quad {}+ b^2c^3 + c^3a^2 + c^2a^3? \end{aligned} \]

solutions.text:
By Vieta’s formulas, \(a + b + c = 0,\) \(ab + bc + ca = k,\) and \(abc = -1.\)

Group the sum as \[ \begin{aligned} &a^2b^2(a + b) + b^2c^2(b + c) \\ &\quad {}+ c^2a^2(c + a). \end{aligned} \] Since \(a + b + c = 0,\) we have \(a + b = -c,\) \(b + c = -a,\) \(c + a = -b.\)

So the sum equals \[ \begin{gathered} -a^2b^2 c - ab^2c^2 - a^2bc^2 \\ = -abc(ab + bc + ca) \\ = -(-1)(k) = k. \end{gathered} \]

Thus, the correct answer is E.
